incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: high-rate GPU prefill OOMs detected on pool 'hotpool-4'. Containers restarting (5xx) — 37 restarts in last 6m. Auto-escalating to #incidents.
marc-oncall: I'm on pager. Acknowledging — collecting initial triage.
emma-sre: seeing repeated OOMs with stacktrace referencing `alloc_kv_cache` during prefill. Crash loops correlate with long-context requests (>120k tokens). Logs: ```
E tensorflow: CUDA out of memory trying to allocate 1.2GiB
Container crash: SIGKILL
``` 
sriram-eng-runtime: likely KV cache blowup from very long prompts + prefetch. Are these user sessions pinned to hotpool-4? Any hot routes?
marc-oncall: yes, traffic routed from region-us-east-1, model variant rdx-13b-q4 linked to hotpool-4. I see a spike from a single customer request pattern (batch of long prefill jobs).
tina-custops: customer-signal: one large enterprise reported increased latency and some 500s on long chat threads. Support ticket #2468 opened, customer impacted sessions ~3% of their calls.
deploy-bot: Recent deploy at 6192836000: rollout rdx-13b-q4 perf flags enabled (aggressive prefetch). Rolling back would require canary stop.
emma-sre: mitigation idea 1: disable aggressive prefetch on hotpool-4 (runtime flag `kv_prefetch=false`) to stop prefill aggressive allocations. Mitigation idea 2: route long-context traffic to coldmodel (rdx-13b-cold) which streams slower but uses less GPU memory.
marc-oncall: doing 1) toggle prefetch now, 2) add transient routing rule to drop >100k token requests to coldmodel, 3) temporarily scale hotpool-4 down to 6 pods to limit churn.
sriram-eng-runtime: command to flip flag: ``kubectl exec -n inference svc/hotpool-4-config -- /bin/sh -c "./update-config --kv_prefetch=false"``. Will apply and watch.
infra-ops: if node-level fragmentation persists we should cordon the worst offending node: `kubectl cordon node/gpu-23` and migrate pods.
marc-oncall: I flipped kv_prefetch=false (performed change). Watching metrics. Container restarts dropping from 6m window: 37 -> 4 -> 0 in last 3m. :white_check_mark:
emma-sre: good signal. Starting a slow canary to route long sessions to coldmodel; also set a short-term token cap on route for 200k -> 100k.
tina-custops: notifying customer: sent update that we're mitigating by throttling extremely long prefill requests and routing heavy sessions to lower-memory path. ETA 30m for full stabilization.
sriram-eng-runtime: follow-up: open PR for a short-term kernel-level guard to prevent unbounded kv allocations for prefill; will include quota and graceful fallback (coldmodel) and a test harness.
marc-oncall: handoff to night oncall @emma-sre in 45m. Will add action items to incident doc and start postmortem draft: root cause hypothesis = aggressive prefetch + large-context requests -> kv cache OOM -> container restarts.
incident-bot: Incident severity updated to P2. Incident timeline and actions recorded: https://redwood.internal/incidents/6192837456
marc-oncall: final note: rollback not required thanks to flag flip. Team, please add any customer-facing notes to #support-updates. We'll reconvene in 2h for postmortem.
